description: Classification -> selector map for `harness.merge` (ADR 0007 D5, Workstream C). The merge task computes propagation targets from the snowfall layout at run time; this file carries only the small classification->selector mapping materialised into the change-proposal manifest. No hand-maintained registry.

delta.description: A harness merge is bounded: the landed delta must be a subset of the inner trees (ADR 0007 D4).

layout.note: Propagation targets are layout-derived: an inner system under x86_64-linux/<spice>-<agent>_inner propagates to the outer x86_64-docker/<spice>-<agent> image; an inner home propagates to the matching outer home (same linux platform). The platform map is the only static part. The child checkout keeps the spice directory suffix: ai-/darkGreen-/tangerineDream-green.

harness-module.note: Shared modules are not part of the bounded inner delta; they require the harness/shared-module loop (edit parent, then update the child's parent input).

scaffolding.note: Child scaffolding is intentionally untracked and must never merge back.
